GPIO register selection (PC4/ClrR=identity, PC5/H_L=count), no parallel-write dependency, identity 0x4C43 without popping FIFO and sticky FIFO full status.
Preserve long-idle time markers; configurable timer width for regression simulation, production width unchanged at 26 bits.
